issue_context.title: Expiry.EndOfMonth Returns Unexpected Values
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
`Expiry.EndOfMonth` returns the 1st day of the following month. 

#### Actual Behavior
Edge case in January:
```csharp
var x = Expiry.EndOfMonth(new DateTime(2020,1,31));   // x -> 20200130
var y = Expiry.EndOfMonth(new DateTime(2020,1,30));   // y -> 20200131
var z = Expiry.EndOfMonth(new DateTime(2020,1,29));   // z -> 20200201 (expected)
```
#### Potential Solution
Review and fix the logic.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
